Update the lifecycle status of a store. Store owners may only toggle between 'active' and 'inactive'. Admins may set any valid status: active, inactive, suspended, pending_approval. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.
Public paginated listing of all ACTIVE stores. No authentication required.

Paginated list of stores filtered by a specific status. Valid statuses: active, inactive, suspended, pending_approval. Requires ADMIN role.
Returns all ACTIVE stores within the given radius (km) from the specified coordinates, sorted by distance ascending. Distance is returned in metres in the response. Requires authentication.
Returns all stores owned by the currently authenticated user, across all statuses. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.

request.description: Update an existing food item. Only the store owner or an admin may call this. Items in terminal states (DELETED, CANCELLED) cannot be updated. The discount percentage is automatically recalculated. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.
Soft-delete a food item by setting its status to DELETED. The item will no longer appear in any query results. Only the store owner or an admin may call this. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.

query.description: Store owners may only set: cancelled. Admins may set: pending, available, sold_out, expired, cancelled.

request.description: Manually update a food item's status. Store owners may only cancel their own items. Admins can set any valid status except 'deleted' (use the DELETE endpoint for that). Valid values: pending, available, sold_out, expired, cancelled. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.
Retrieve a single food item by its ID. Response includes computed fields: isAvailable, timeUntilSaleStart, timeUntilSaleEnd (in seconds). No authentication required.
Paginated list of all food items across all statuses (except DELETED). Sorted by creation date descending by default. No authentication required.
Paginated list of all food items belonging to a specific store. No authentication required.
Paginated list of food items belonging to a specific category. No authentication required.
Paginated list of food items filtered by status. Valid values: pending, available, sold_out, expired, cancelled. No authentication required.
Paginated list of food items with AVAILABLE status that still have stock and have not expired. Items are sorted by flash price ascending by default (best deals first). No authentication required.

Paginated list of food items that are currently within their active flash-sale window (saleStartTime <= now < saleEndTime), with AVAILABLE status and positive stock. Sorted by discount percentage descending by default (biggest discount first). No authentication required.
Case-insensitive keyword search across food item name and description. The keyword must not be blank. No authentication required.

Place a new flash-sale order for the currently authenticated customer. Validates item availability, flash-sale window, and stock before confirming. Inventory is decremented atomically under pessimistic write-lock to prevent overselling. A corresponding Payment record is created simultaneously. Requires CUSTOMER role.

Cancel an order. Customers may only cancel their own PENDING orders. Store owners and admins may cancel PENDING or CONFIRMED orders belonging to their store. Reserved inventory is restored atomically. The request body is optional — omit it or leave 'reason' blank if no reason is needed. Requires CUSTOMER, STORE_OWNER, or ADMIN role.
Store owner or admin confirms a PENDING order, transitioning it to CONFIRMED. The customer receives a notification. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.
Mark a CONFIRMED order as actively being prepared, transitioning it to PREPARING. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.
Mark a PREPARING order as ready for customer pickup, transitioning it to READY. A notification is sent to the customer. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.
Mark a READY order as completed after the customer has picked it up, transitioning it to COMPLETED. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.

Simulate payment processing for a PENDING order. Updates the Payment record status to PAID and synchronises the paymentStatus field on the Order. Cannot be called on already-paid, cancelled, or expired orders. Requires CUSTOMER role.
Retrieve a single order by its database ID. Access is restricted to the order's customer, the owning store's staff, or admins. Requires authentication.
Retrieve a single order by its human-readable order number (format: ORD-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX). Access is restricted to the order's customer, the owning store's staff, or admins. Requires authentication.
Paginated list of all orders placed by the currently authenticated customer, sorted by creation date descending. Requires CUSTOMER role.
Paginated list of the current customer's orders filtered by status. Valid status values: pending, confirmed, preparing, ready, completed, cancelled, expired. Requires CUSTOMER role.
Paginated list of all orders belonging to a specific store. The caller must be the owner of that store or an admin. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.
Paginated list of a store's orders filtered by status. Valid status values: pending, confirmed, preparing, ready, completed, cancelled, expired. Requires STORE_OWNER or ADMIN role.
Paginated list of all orders across all stores and customers. Requires ADMIN role.
